_comment: Config for the /creative-engine skill. The `kraken` block is connection-level only: The Kraken's Content Library is a Supabase store (content_outputs + Storage buckets), NOT local folders. Source/destination folders and the workspace (AA location) are chosen PER RUN and saved to campaigns/<name>/kraken.json — never here. supabaseHost is stored WITHOUT scheme. credentialsEnvPath points at The Kraken's gitignored .env.local; the service-role + anon keys are read from there at runtime and never copied into this repo. brands maps a spoken brand name to its slug + the data-tier file used for the cascade fill (data/brand.<dataTier>.json) and its brand-kit path.
